item_weight_check.name: item_weight_check
item_weight_check.value: ("item"."unit" = 'KG' and "item"."standard_weight_kg" is null) or ("item"."unit" <> 'KG' and "item"."standard_weight_kg" is not null and "item"."standard_weight_kg" > 0)

item_code_check.name: item_code_check
item_code_check.value: char_length("item"."code") between 2 and 30 and "item"."code" = upper("item"."code") and "item"."code" = btrim("item"."code") and "item"."code" !~ '[,*+ -]{2}' and "item"."code" !~ '^[,*+ -]|[,*+ -]$'

item_alias_code_check.name: item_alias_code_check
item_alias_code_check.value: char_length("item_alias"."code") between 2 and 30 and "item_alias"."code" = upper("item_alias"."code") and "item_alias"."code" = btrim("item_alias"."code") and "item_alias"."code" !~ '[,*+ -]{2}' and "item_alias"."code" !~ '^[,*+ -]|[,*+ -]$'

kit_code_check.name: kit_code_check
kit_code_check.value: char_length("kit"."code") between 2 and 30 and "kit"."code" = upper("kit"."code") and "kit"."code" = btrim("kit"."code") and "kit"."code" !~ '[,*+ -]{2}' and "kit"."code" !~ '^[,*+ -]|[,*+ -]$'

inventory_ledger_movement_check.name: inventory_ledger_movement_check
inventory_ledger_movement_check.value: ("inventory_ledger"."movement" in ('OPENING', 'PURCHASE_IN', 'REPAIR_IN', 'DELIVERY_IN', 'RETURN_IN', 'TRANSFER_IN', 'ADJUST_IN') and "inventory_ledger"."quantity" > 0 and "inventory_ledger"."location_id" is not null) or ("inventory_ledger"."movement" in ('REPAIR_OUT', 'DELIVERY_OUT', 'RETURN_OUT', 'TRANSFER_OUT', 'SALE_OUT', 'ADJUST_OUT') and "inventory_ledger"."quantity" < 0 and "inventory_ledger"."location_id" is not null) or ("inventory_ledger"."movement" = 'REVALUE' and "inventory_ledger"."quantity" = 0 and "inventory_ledger"."location_id" is null)

stock_adjustment_revalue_check.name: stock_adjustment_revalue_check
stock_adjustment_revalue_check.value:
("stock_adjustment"."kind" <> 'REVALUE' or "stock_adjustment"."related_document_code" is not null)
        and (("stock_adjustment"."source_receipt_id" is null and "stock_adjustment"."recorded_trip_cost" is null and "stock_adjustment"."corrected_trip_cost" is null)
          or ("stock_adjustment"."kind" = 'REVALUE' and "stock_adjustment"."source_receipt_id" is not null and "stock_adjustment"."recorded_trip_cost" >= 0 and "stock_adjustment"."corrected_trip_cost" >= 0))

stock_adjustment_line_condition_check.name: stock_adjustment_line_condition_check
stock_adjustment_line_condition_check.value: "stock_adjustment_line"."condition" in ('NEW', 'GOOD', 'NEEDS_REPAIR', 'SCRAP') and ("stock_adjustment_line"."to_condition" is null or "stock_adjustment_line"."to_condition" in ('NEW', 'GOOD', 'NEEDS_REPAIR', 'SCRAP'))

stock_adjustment_line_shape_check.name: stock_adjustment_line_shape_check
stock_adjustment_line_shape_check.value:
("stock_adjustment_line"."line_type" = 'QUANTITY' and "stock_adjustment_line"."quantity" <> 0 and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_condition" is null and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_location_id" is null and "stock_adjustment_line"."location_id" is not null and "stock_adjustment_line"."value_delta" is null)
        or ("stock_adjustment_line"."line_type" = 'CONDITION' and "stock_adjustment_line"."quantity" > 0 and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_condition" is not null and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_condition" <> "stock_adjustment_line"."condition" and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_location_id" is null and "stock_adjustment_line"."location_id" is not null and "stock_adjustment_line"."value_delta" is null)
        or ("stock_adjustment_line"."line_type" = 'LOCATION' and "stock_adjustment_line"."quantity" > 0 and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_location_id" is not null and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_location_id" <> "stock_adjustment_line"."location_id" and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_condition" is null and "stock_adjustment_line"."location_id" is not null and "stock_adjustment_line"."value_delta" is null)
        or ("stock_adjustment_line"."line_type" = 'OPENING' and "stock_adjustment_line"."quantity" > 0 and "stock_adjustment_line"."unit_cost" is not null and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_condition" is null and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_location_id" is null and "stock_adjustment_line"."location_id" is not null and "stock_adjustment_line"."value_delta" is null)
        or ("stock_adjustment_line"."line_type" = 'VALUE' and "stock_adjustment_line"."quantity" = 0 and "stock_adjustment_line"."value_delta" <> 0 and "stock_adjustment_line"."location_id" is null and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_condition" is null and "stock_adjustment_line"."to_location_id" is null and "stock_adjustment_line"."unit_cost" is null)

purchase_order_outcome_check.name: purchase_order_outcome_check
purchase_order_outcome_check.value: ("purchase_order"."status" = 'DONE') = ("purchase_order"."outcome" is not null) and ("purchase_order"."outcome" is null or "purchase_order"."outcome" in ('RECEIVED', 'CLOSED', 'CANCELLED'))

purchase_order_cancel_check.name: purchase_order_cancel_check
purchase_order_cancel_check.value: "purchase_order"."outcome" is distinct from 'CANCELLED' or "purchase_order"."end_reason" is not null

goods_receipt_line_values_check.name: goods_receipt_line_values_check
goods_receipt_line_values_check.value: "goods_receipt_line"."quantity" >= 0 and ("goods_receipt_line"."weighed_kg" is null or "goods_receipt_line"."weighed_kg" > 0) and "goods_receipt_line"."qty_new" >= 0 and "goods_receipt_line"."qty_good" >= 0 and "goods_receipt_line"."qty_needs_repair" >= 0 and "goods_receipt_line"."qty_scrap" >= 0

goods_receipt_line_state_check.name: goods_receipt_line_state_check
goods_receipt_line_state_check.value: ("goods_receipt_line"."status" = 'NOT_IN_TRIP' and "goods_receipt_line"."quantity" = 0 and "goods_receipt_line"."weighed_kg" is null) or ("goods_receipt_line"."status" = 'COUNTED' and "goods_receipt_line"."quantity" > 0)

repair_order_posted_check.name: repair_order_posted_check
repair_order_posted_check.value: ("repair_order"."status" = 'DRAFT' and "repair_order"."posted_by" is null and "repair_order"."posted_at" is null and "repair_order"."posting_id" is null) or ("repair_order"."status" = 'POSTED' and "repair_order"."posted_by" is not null and "repair_order"."posted_at" is not null and "repair_order"."posting_id" is not null)

repair_order_text_check.name: repair_order_text_check
repair_order_text_check.value: ("repair_order"."repaired_by" is null or length("repair_order"."repaired_by") between 1 and 100) and ("repair_order"."note" is null or length("repair_order"."note") between 1 and 500)

stocktake_done_check.name: stocktake_done_check
stocktake_done_check.value: ("stocktake"."status" = 'DONE') = ("stocktake"."approved_at" is not null and "stocktake"."approved_by" is not null)

stocktake_cancelled_check.name: stocktake_cancelled_check
stocktake_cancelled_check.value: ("stocktake"."status" = 'CANCELLED') = ("stocktake"."cancelled_at" is not null and "stocktake"."cancelled_by" is not null and "stocktake"."cancel_reason" is not null)

stocktake_reason_check.name: stocktake_reason_check
stocktake_reason_check.value: ("stocktake"."returned_reason" is null or length("stocktake"."returned_reason") between 1 and 500) and ("stocktake"."cancel_reason" is null or length("stocktake"."cancel_reason") between 1 and 500)

stocktake_line_count_check.name: stocktake_line_count_check
stocktake_line_count_check.value: ("stocktake_line"."counted_at" is null and "stocktake_line"."counted_quantity" is null and "stocktake_line"."book_quantity" is null) or ("stocktake_line"."counted_at" is not null and "stocktake_line"."counted_quantity" is not null and "stocktake_line"."book_quantity" is not null and "stocktake_line"."counted_quantity" >= 0)

contract_delivery_batch_note_check.name: contract_delivery_batch_note_check
contract_delivery_batch_note_check.value: "contract_delivery_batch"."note" is null or length("contract_delivery_batch"."note") between 1 and 200

contract_deposit_shape_check.name: contract_deposit_shape_check
contract_deposit_shape_check.value: "contract_deposit"."amount" > 0 and (("contract_deposit"."kind" = 'CASH' and "contract_deposit"."method" is not null and "contract_deposit"."method" in ('CASH', 'TRANSFER') and "contract_deposit"."bank_name" is null and "contract_deposit"."guarantee_number" is null and "contract_deposit"."expiry_date" is null) or ("contract_deposit"."kind" = 'GUARANTEE' and "contract_deposit"."method" is null and "contract_deposit"."bank_name" is not null and "contract_deposit"."guarantee_number" is not null and length("contract_deposit"."bank_name") between 1 and 100 and length("contract_deposit"."guarantee_number") between 1 and 50 and "contract_deposit"."expiry_date" is not null))

contract_line_pricing_unit_check.name: contract_line_pricing_unit_check
contract_line_pricing_unit_check.value: "contract_line"."pricing_unit" in ('ITEM', 'KG') and ("contract_line"."condition" is distinct from 'SCRAP' or "contract_line"."pricing_unit" = 'KG')

contract_line_price_check.name: contract_line_price_check
contract_line_price_check.value: ("contract_line"."price" is null or "contract_line"."price" >= 0) and ("contract_line"."catalog_price" is null or "contract_line"."catalog_price" >= 0)

contract_revision_approved_check.name: contract_revision_approved_check
contract_revision_approved_check.value: "contract_revision"."status" <> 'APPROVED' or ("contract_revision"."approved_by" is not null and "contract_revision"."approved_at" is not null)

contract_revision_terms_check.name: contract_revision_terms_check
contract_revision_terms_check.value: "contract_revision"."payment_terms_days" between 0 and 365 and ("contract_revision"."min_rental_days" is null or "contract_revision"."min_rental_days" between 1 and 365) and ("contract_revision"."billing_cycle" is null or "contract_revision"."billing_cycle" = 'MONTH_END')

contract_revision_vat_check.name: contract_revision_vat_check
contract_revision_vat_check.value: ("contract_revision"."vat_enabled" and "contract_revision"."vat_rate" is not null and "contract_revision"."vat_rate" > 0 and "contract_revision"."vat_rate" <= 20) or (not "contract_revision"."vat_enabled" and "contract_revision"."vat_rate" is null)

contract_revision_money_check.name: contract_revision_money_check
contract_revision_money_check.value: ("contract_revision"."freight_per_trip" is null or "contract_revision"."freight_per_trip" >= 0) and ("contract_revision"."overdue_amount" is null or "contract_revision"."overdue_amount" >= 0)

contract_revision_text_check.name: contract_revision_text_check
contract_revision_text_check.value: ("contract_revision"."reason" is null or length("contract_revision"."reason") between 1 and 500) and ("contract_revision"."approval_reason" is null or length("contract_revision"."approval_reason") between 1 and 500) and ("contract_revision"."note" is null or length("contract_revision"."note") between 1 and 1000)

delivery_note_posted_check.name: delivery_note_posted_check
delivery_note_posted_check.value: ("delivery_note"."status" = 'POSTED') = ("delivery_note"."business_date" is not null and "delivery_note"."posting_id" is not null and "delivery_note"."client_draft_id" is not null and "delivery_note"."posted_by" is not null and "delivery_note"."posted_at" is not null and "delivery_note"."contract_revision_id" is not null)

delivery_note_picking_check.name: delivery_note_picking_check
delivery_note_picking_check.value: "delivery_note"."status" <> 'PICKING' or ("delivery_note"."picking_by" is not null and "delivery_note"."picking_started_at" is not null)

delivery_note_text_check.name: delivery_note_text_check
delivery_note_text_check.value: ("delivery_note"."vehicle_plate" is null or length("delivery_note"."vehicle_plate") between 1 and 20) and ("delivery_note"."note" is null or length("delivery_note"."note") between 1 and 500) and ("delivery_note"."returned_reason" is null or length("delivery_note"."returned_reason") between 1 and 500) and ("delivery_note"."cancelled_reason" is null or length("delivery_note"."cancelled_reason") between 1 and 500)

delivery_note_line_shape_check.name: delivery_note_line_shape_check
delivery_note_line_shape_check.value: ("delivery_note_line"."condition" is null and "delivery_note_line"."pricing_unit" is null and "delivery_note_line"."unit_price" is null) or ("delivery_note_line"."condition" in ('NEW', 'GOOD', 'SCRAP') and "delivery_note_line"."pricing_unit" in ('ITEM', 'KG') and ("delivery_note_line"."condition" <> 'SCRAP' or "delivery_note_line"."pricing_unit" = 'KG'))

delivery_note_pick_quantity_check.name: delivery_note_pick_quantity_check
delivery_note_pick_quantity_check.value: "delivery_note_pick"."quantity" > 0 and ("delivery_note_pick"."weighed_kg" is null or "delivery_note_pick"."weighed_kg" > 0) and (not "delivery_note_pick"."pieces_estimated" or "delivery_note_pick"."weighed_kg" is not null)
